name: Prime Module
description: Following in the footsteps of Orion Pax, even the meekest of bots, in the darkest of times, can find the strength to prevail while wielding the power of the Primes.

name: Harm Accelerator
description: A module that doesn't fool around. Drop this mod on a node and watch your opponent take a trip to destination pain.

name: EMI Module
description: Electrostatic Interference obstructs even the most sophisticated guidance systems, preventing enemies in the vicinity from landing effective projectile attacks.

name: Repair Module
description: The Earth Defense Command's standard-issue module for repairing broken machinery. It periodically repairs your Base Defender.

name: Strange Refractor
description: The efficiency of your Base Defender's Block is improved by refracting electromagnetic waves through an upside-down dimension.

name: Superconductor-1000
description: Using an array of supercooled magnetic coils, the Superconductor 1000 amplifies Special Attack 1 of your Base Defender to devastating levels.

name: Superconductor-2000
description: Using an array of supercooled magnetic coils, the Superconductor 2000 amplifies Special Attack 2 of your Base Defender to devastating levels.

name: Paralyzer
description: One of Wheeljack's early Immobilizer modules that leaves opponents dazed and diffused. Should work great, because we all know Wheeljack's inventions are always aces. Right?

name: Laser Guidance
description: Improves the speed, accuracy, and damage of your Base Defender's projectile attacks using advanced laser-guidance technology.

name: Nightbird's Mark
description: The mark of a giant female ninja robot. It exposes weaknesses in enemies, increasing the effectiveness of your Base Defender's Critical Hits. Doctor Fujiyama would be proud.

name: Brawler's Fury
description: Supercharges melee combos and grants bonus attack power when defender health is low.

name: Demolitions Cache
description: Supplies heavy explosive payloads, causing defender heavy attacks to ignite detonations.

name: Exo-Filter
description: After an exocomet crashed near Moonbase Two, a series of exo-tech was developed from its ore, including the mysterious Exo-Filter.

name: Transwarp Cell
description: Transform and warp enemy power with the perfect accessory for any space-time traveler. Place this Module on your Base and pair it with a Bot known for their reliable Heavy Attacks for maximum performance.

name: Robot Resource
description: One green and one pink crystal resonate at frequencies that amplify Power generation in your Base Defender.

name: Scout's Sentry
description: With knowledge of your weaknesses and the agility to strike first, Scout Bots eliminates opponents without recourse.

name: Security Protocol
description: The Security Module generates Armor Buffs for your Base Defenders as a defense mechanism. It was manufactured after a malfunction with an image-decompression protocom ray.

name: Tactician's Trick
description: Inverts enemy combat advantages and confuses their special attack timings.

name: Tech Console
description: A seemingly-innocuous programming interface capable of mechanical annihilation in the hands of Tech Bots.

name: Warrior's Call
description: Inspires base defenders with temporary invulnerability and unstoppable offensive fury.

name: Generic Offence
description: Standard offensive module that amplifies basic attack damage.

name: Generic Defense
description: Standard defensive module that provides a solid boost to maximum health and armor.

name: Generic Utility
description: Standard utility module that enhances stamina recovery and combat utility.

name: Attack Module
description: Employs energon blade resonators to massively empower base defender attacks.

name: Health Module
description: Emits vitality resonance fields, significantly increasing defender maximum health points.
